title: aristolochia elegans var. hassleriana
intro: Aristolochia elegans var. hassleriana, commonly known as the Hassler's birthwort, is a species of flowering plant in the Aristolochiaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Hassler's birthwort include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include aristolochic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although it's worth noting that excessive consumption can be toxic.
